editor_override: CAST TRUTH IMAGE VIOLATION (§3): The cover shows Elon Musk, but he has no role in this story. The story is about advertiser ROI data on X — Musk is not named, not quoted, and not an actor in any slide. His face is being used as a brand proxy for X, which is exactly what the doctrine prohibits: 'if a recognizable famous person is the cover subject but that person has no role in this story, REJECT.'
